content.title: Ernexa Therapeutics announces 1-for-15 reverse stock split
content.summary: Ernexa Therapeutics (ERNA) announced a reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding shares of common stock, par value $0.005 per share at a ratio of 1-for-15, effective June 12, 2025 at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time. content.title: Eterna appoints Zeldis, Sather to scientific advisory board
content.summary: Eterna (ERNA) Therapeutics announced the addition of Jerome Zeldis, M.D., Ph.D., and Blythe Sather, Ph.D., to the company’s scientific advisory board. With their deep insight and experience in cell therapy, Dr. Zeldis and Dr. Blythe will play a role in advancing ERNA-101 in solid tumors and ERNA-102 in autoimmune diseases through their preclinical studies.
